en: A vintage, color-tinted postcard showing a wide boulevard lined with ornate, historic buildings, with visible tram tracks and an old-fashioned tram traveling along the street. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage add a turn-of-the-century feel. The street is named 'Herrengasse' and is located in Graz, as indicated by the text at the top right. The buildings feature classical European architecture with decorative facades and domed towers in the background.
